MANDARIN CHINESE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Orthography ● Strokes ● Stroke order ● Characters ● Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Orthography ● Strokes ● Stroke order ● Characters ● Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Orthography ● Strokes ● Stroke order ● Characters ● Handwriting.

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Orthography ● Strokes ● Stroke order ● Characters ● Handwriting.

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading Aloud ● Fluency ● Pronunciation ● Articulation.

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Phonological Awareness.

5. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Orthography ● Strokes ● Stroke order ● Characters ● Handwriting.

6. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 1.4.1 Word Classes ● Demonstrative pronouns 这 and 那 as attributives ● Ad.

7. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Oral Presentation ● Clarity and articulation ● Flue.

8. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading Fluency.

9. C — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

10. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency ● Appropriate expression ● Articulation.

11. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 2.4.1 Word Classes ● Preposition 在 ● Interrogative pronoun 哪儿.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading 4.2.1. Reading for Information; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Writing 4.3.1 Descriptive Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Grammar 4.4.1 Sentence Structures; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
